en.apiKeyHint: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
en.apiKeyUnset: No key is configured; searches will fail until one is saved.
en.baseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the provider default (https://google.serper.dev).
en.description: Results merge DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary). Advanced settings (ratio, summary length, timeouts) live in cordis.patch.yml.
en.glHint: Google country code, e.g. cn or us. Leave blank for the provider default.
en.hlHint: Interface language, e.g. zh-cn or en. Leave blank for the provider default.
en.invalidBoolean: Enter true or false, or leave blank to use the default.
en.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
en.nativeHint: true = every search also queries the DeepSeek Search API and interleaves its sources with Google 2:1 (wider coverage, ~0.005 CNY per search); false = serper only.
en.numHint: Candidate pool size per search (1-100); the model still sees at most the tool layer result cap (8 by default).
en.probeAccountOnly: No API key detected; if you use a DeepSeek Account session in chat, search still works.
en.probeCostHint: Each test costs one serper and one DeepSeek search.
en.probeFailed: The self-check did not run; try again in a moment.
en.probeUnsupported: This deployment does not expose the self-check routes, so it is unavailable here.
en.providerSwitchFailed: The provider setting was not accepted; try again.
en.providerTaken: This machine now uses the plugin
en.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
en.title: Serper + DeepSeek search
en.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
en.updateFailed: Could not reach the npm registry.
en.updateHint: The Host reads the npm registry, so no browser CORS is involved.
